title: 2027 - Summer Software Engineer Intern, Dublin
description: We’re seeking curious minds like yours to collaborate with full-time engineers and cross functional teammates, learn development standard methodologies, and gain practical software engineering experience. Software engineering interns are fully integrated into software engineering teams across our Product and Technology organization. Interns spend their summer pushing production-level code to make lasting contributions across MongoDB’s products and services for our internal teams, external customers, and developer end users. This is a 10 week internship starting in June 2027. **What We Are Looking For In You (qualifications)** * In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Have a foundation in computer science theory, with proficiencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design. * Fluent in any one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Go, C++, Javascript, Node.js - or a comparable object-oriented programming language. * Have a minimum of one quarter/semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. Graduation date in, Spring 2028, Summer 2028, Fall 2028, Spring 2029 or Summer 2029. * Must be authorized to work in Ireland and provide the Company with copies of all relevant documents, if requested. Company sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates applying for certain roles. What you'll find at MongoDB * Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work, we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation. * Personalized Mentorship: Pair up with an engineering Mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to foster your growth. * Career Coaching Sessions: Access to a tailored training program designed uniquely for interns’ personal and professional development. * Work-Life Harmony: Embrace "Bloom for Interns" with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more! * Impactful Projects: Contribute to projects where you can Make it Matter - your meaningful work will see the light of day. * Exclusive Networking: Attend "Speaker Series" and "Get to Knows" to connect with our executives and departmental leaders. * Vibrant Community: Build connections with fellow interns and join after-work social events, virtual gatherings, and local city activities to create connections and friendships. * Relocation Support: Housing to allow you to comfortably settle into your new location. * Path to Full-Time: A chance to see if MongoDB is where you see yourself long term with the possibility of receiving a full time offer at the end of the summer! MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks lasting from dates in June until August. All interns are considered hybrid employees, designated the "in office" working model and are expected to be in their office location 3-5 days a week. Due to the high volume of applications our Early Talent Recruitment Team receives, it may take up to six weeks to hear back regarding an update on your application status. Our goal is to get back sooner, but we appreciate your patience as our team carefully reviews each application. **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. *Req ID: 3273577066*

title: Account Executive, SMB - French Market
description: **Company Overview** Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). What you'll do As an SMB Account Executive at Docusign, you will drive revenue growth and market expansion across small and medium-sized businesses. This role requires a dynamic, adaptable sales professional who can seamlessly balance high-velocity transactional sales with strategic, multi-threaded platform deals. As Docusign expands into Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) and Al-driven agreement solutions, you will translate complex capabilities into measurable business value for C-suite buyers. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Regional Vice President, SMB Sales. **Responsibility** * Meet and exceed quarterly quotas and target continuous double-digit growth through new customer acquisition and account expansion * Proactively build a healthy pipeline using outbound prospecting strategies, modern sales tools, and multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) * Conduct deep discovery to understand customer pain points across HR, Legal Procurement, and Operations. Simplify complex IAM and Al features into clear ROI and business outcomes * Use structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC) to manage deal velocity, navigate longer sales cycles, and maintain accurate forecasting * Maintain real-time CRM integrity in Salesforce, manage daily workflow efficiency, and keep high deal volumes moving predictably * Collaborate with Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and Legal to ensure seamless deal execution and customer onboarding Job Designation **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. What you bring **Basic** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience * Experience in a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role within SaaS or technology * Fluent in Italian * Experience demonstrating consistent quota achievement (100%+ attainment) * Experience with Salesforce (or HubSpot) and prospecting tools (e.g., Sales Navigator, Outreach) **Preferred** * Experience balancing high-velocity transactional selling with broader platform deals * Formal training in recognized sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, SPIN Selling) * Exceptional communication skills with the ability to quickly establish trust with external business leaders * Adaptable, resilient, and eager to leverage new Al and agreement management tools * Knowledge of legal and regulatory frameworks surrounding digital agreements Life at Docusign **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance. **AI in Our Hiring Process** At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy. title: Account Executive, SaaS Platforms Grower
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** The Startup SaaS Platform team works with European startups in one of Stripe’s must-win segments. At Stripe, SaaS platforms are companies that use Stripe to embed payments and make financial services a core part of their product. Their partnership with Stripe is vital to their business success. Examples include Shopify, Mindbody, and Lightspeed. SaaS platforms are a global priority for Stripe. Our team identifies and develops Stripe’s future strategic accounts in Europe. We identify and partner with high-potential companies, helping them leverage Stripe’s solutions to better support their users, scale globally, and create new revenue streams through monetisation of payments and financial services. What you'll do As a Grower Account Executive on the Startup SaaS Platforms team, you’ll drive Stripe’s future growth through account expansion and client retention. You’ll advise businesses on how to optimise their operations using Stripe solutions. You’ll help users understand how Stripe’s modern financial infrastructure supports their growth ambitions and provides a competitive edge for their business or product. **Responsibilities** * Directly manage and cultivate a named list of existing user accounts, while crafting account plans to expand business and retain clients * Understand users’ pain points and Stripe’s value for SaaS platform clients, proposing tailored solutions that support their long-term growth * Guide clients through complex evaluations of Stripe solutions for SaaS platforms, working with cross-functional teams across Product, Risk, and Operations to move new projects through activation and adoption * Develop and execute strategic programs that deepen product adoption and maximise effective utilisation across the current user base * Foster executive relationships with stakeholders at existing clients to drive retention and identify expansion opportunities * Work with cross-functional teams on shared initiatives that drive internal efficiency and broader business impact * Contribute to Stripe’s go-to-market priority to expand the user base and optimise the renewals motion Who you are * You’re a curious, well-rounded strategic seller who builds strong relationships with Stripe’s clients in this key segment. You’re comfortable owning your territory and balancing a mix of high-value, strategic deals with smaller, high-velocity deal cycles. * You’re solution-oriented and adaptable, with an interest in developing yourself and getting things done. You enjoy highly technical sales cycles and working with a diverse group of internal stakeholders. * We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * 4+ years of experience in a client-facing or closing sales role * Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and manage complex sales cycles * Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams * Ability to build relationships with technical customers, work with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, contribute to team success, and share knowledge * Motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fluid environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience in a sales or customer-facing role at a high-growth technology company * Comfort interpreting and discussing API-first solutions In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €133,300 - €199,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

timely delivery within agreed controls * Reconciling supplier statements, corporate credit card transactions and bank accounts * Reviewing aded creditor balances and resolving outstanding items * completeness, accuracy and delivery to agreed deadlines * Prioritising internal and external queries, ensuring timely responses and following issues through to resolution * Tracking outstanding actions through to completion, coordinating with relevant stakeholders and escalating risks to delivery early, with clear recommendations * Investigating invoice, payment and reconciliations discrepencies, working with relevant teams to identify causes and implement solutions, that reduce recurring issues * Planning and managing competing priorities to meet payment and month end deadlines while maintaining accuracy and complying with internal controls * Building effective relationships with colleagues, vendors and other stakeholders through clear communication and timely follow up * Identifying and implementing practical improvement opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual work and strengthen controls, helping AP operations handle growing transaction volumes efficiently * Supporting system changes and automation projects through testing, feedback and procedure updates * Providing cover for colleagues through task rotation and knowledge sharing, and providing practical guidance on complex AP queries * Undertaking ad hoc duties to support the wider Finance team **What We're Looking For** * Substantial relevant experience in accounts payable or a comparable finance operations role, ideally 5 years' or more, inclduing experience managing high transaction volumes and taking ownership of key AP processes * A third level qualification in Finance or Accounting, or equivalent practical experience * Strong attention to detail and the ability to organise, reconcile and analyse large volumes of data, using findings to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities * Proven ability to balance operational delivery with improvement work, manage competing priorities and take accountability for accurate, timely outcomes * Ability to proactively communicate progress, risks and next steps to stakeholders * Ability to identify root causes and drive practical solutions through to resolution and recognise when escalation is needed * A collaborative and adaptable approach , with a willingness to learn new systems, share expertise, and take on different responsibilities * Driving and delivering to a process improvement, system change or project, with demonstrated ownership and the resulting benefits to efficiency, accuracy or processing capacity. * Experience using General Ledger and Accounts Payable systems, with an understanding of balance sheet accounts and reconciliations. title: Architectural Technician - BIM

documentation and contract administration reports. * Provide advice on building fabric, construction methods, materials and statutory requirements. * Support refurbishment, alteration and building improvement projects from inception through to completion. **Condition Surveying** * Undertake planned preventative maintenance (PPM) inspections and building condition surveys. * Assess the condition of building fabric, structural elements and associated components. * Prepare detailed condition reports, including photographic records, defect analysis and recommendations. * Develop planned maintenance programmes and lifecycle cost assessments. * Identify maintenance priorities and provide budget estimates for short, medium and long-term capital expenditure. * Support clients with property portfolio management and asset management strategies. **Commercial Surveying** * Provide building surveying advice to commercial property owners, occupiers, landlords and tenants. * Undertake pre- and post-acquisition surveys and inspections. * Advise on dilapidations, schedules of condition, lease obligations and repair liabilities. * Prepare schedules of dilapidations and negotiate or assist with the resolution of related matters. * Provide cost advice, budget estimates and commercial recommendations. * Build and maintain strong client relationships through the delivery of professional, commercially aware advice. **Minor Works** * Assist in the identification, planning and delivery of minor building refurbishment, repair and improvement projects. * Prepare scopes of monitoring duties. * Carry out site inspections to monitor quality, progress, health and safety and compliance with specifications. * Monitor project costs, programmes and contractor performance. * ensure appropriate compliance documentation is provided. * Undertake and coordinate inspections at appropriate stages of construction to verify compliance with the Building Regulations and relevant technical guidance. * Review inspection records, construction documentation, ancillary certificates and supporting evidence. * Identify, record and manage non-compliances, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are implemented. * Maintain accurate inspection records and compile the necessary documentation to support the completion and submission of the Certificate of Compliance on Completion. * Provide technical guidance to clients and project teams on BCAR obligations, statutory compliance and certification requirements. **Independent Building Inspection and Testing** * Undertake independent building inspections and technical compliance assessments across a range of building types and construction projects. * Carry out inspections of building fabric, structural elements, fire safety provisions, accessibility and other relevant building components. * Undertake independent inspections at key construction milestones to assess workmanship, materials, installation quality and compliance with approved design information and specifications. * Coordinate and undertake appropriate independent testing and verification activities, where required, to establish compliance with relevant standards, specifications and regulatory requirements. * Review test results, technical submissions, product certifications and supporting quality assurance documentation. * Identify and report defects, non-conformances and potential compliance risks, providing clear recommendations for remedial action. * Prepare detailed inspection and testing reports, supported by photographic evidence and technical **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what's possible?** Here's what we're looking for: As the successful candidate, you will have some experience working within a building surveying environment and will possess the following qualifications, skills, and experience: **To be successful in this role, you will have:** * Degree qualified in Building Surveying or a closely related discipline. * Ideally working towards, or already holding, MRICS status through the RICS Assessment of Professional Competence (APC). * Experience in building surveying consultancy, ideally within a multidisciplinary professional services environment. * Good technical knowledge of building construction, materials, defects and building pathology. * Experience undertaking building inspections and preparing professional technical reports. * Understanding of construction contracts, procurement processes and contract administration. **Additional Information** Interested in the role or curious about life at AECOM? title: Data Analyst
description: **Overview** TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance. We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will build a reliable picture of how TensorX performs, from revenue and token usage through to GPU capacity and operating costs. You will define the core metrics the business runs on and explain what drives changes in revenue and usage so the management team can plan and invest with confidence. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role with real scope to grow both your technical and commercial skills. The Finance Director will set your priorities, and you will work closely with our technical and commercial teams every day. Our technical team will also help you learn our systems and review your GPU and infrastructure analysis. Much of your data will come from our databases and metrics systems (PostgreSQL, Prometheus and Grafana), and you will help establish the BI tools that the wider business needs. You will handle commercially sensitive usage and billing data in line with our information security controls and customer data commitments. This means token counts, request volumes and spend, but never the content that customers send. TensorX is a founder-backed, execution-led business where people take ownership and work across functions. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems. We value curious people who ask good questions and move easily between technical detail and commercial context. **Responsibilities** * **KPIs & management reporting** - Define and maintain the core KPIs with the management team and produce the monthly management reports, ensuring the numbers mean the same thing to everyone who uses them. * **Revenue & customer analysis** - Analyse customer usage, signups, token consumption, pricing, revenue and profitability. Explain how changes in customer demand, model usage and token volumes affect revenue. * **Financial & operational analysis** - Bring together financial, infrastructure and commercial data to show how the business performs. Build the analysis behind forecasts, financial plans and decisions on infrastructure investment and financing. * **Infrastructure costs & capacity** - Analyse GPU capacity, utilisation, electricity costs (including European energy prices) and other operating costs. Feed the results into capacity planning and show where we can run more efficiently. * **GPU & inference performance** - Analyse GPU utilisation, inference performance and workload efficiency. Track goodput per GPU, which is the number of requests each GPU answers inside the latency target. Run benchmarks with the GPU Performance Team's method and report how the results change over time. Work with engineers to investigate performance issues and measure the effect of each fix. * **Dashboards & automation** - Help establish our BI tools and build reliable dashboards that act as a single source of truth for the business. Combine data from different systems and automate recurring analysis so that routine reports run without manual work. * **Business alerts** - Build alerts on key business metrics, using the monitoring that our technical team already runs. Make sure we hear about a sudden change in revenue, usage or capacity before it becomes a problem. * **Investigation & problem solving** - Take technical, operational and commercial questions from across the business and find the answers in the data. Explain what you find in plain terms and suggest practical improvements. **What Success Looks Like** Within your first 12 months you will have: * Agreed the core KPIs with the management team and made your monthly report their trusted source of numbers * Worked with the technical team to build one view of GPU utilisation and inference performance that the whole company uses * Given the business clear evidence of what drives revenue and why usage growth and revenue growth can differ * Made capacity, electricity and operating costs reliable inputs to capacity planning and the financial model * Helped establish our BI tools, automated most recurring reporting and set up alerts on key business metrics * Shared findings that led to a technical improvement, a commercial decision or a change to a planning assumption **Skills & Experience** * 3+ years of experience in data analysis, technical analytics, business intelligence or a similar role * The ability to work independently and own reporting from end to end * Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills. You can investigate unfamiliar datasets and explain what you find clearly * Practical Python and SQL skills to extract, combine, analyse and check data * Experience defining KPIs and building the dashboards and automated reports that other people rely on * Confidence with revenue, cost, margin, utilisation and other business measures * Some experience supporting forecasts, budgets or financial models * A genuine interest in AI infrastructure and how it works as a business * Comfortable using AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflow * A clear communicator with engineers and non-technical colleagues. You know when to ask for specialist input **Nice to Have** * Experience in GPU computing, AI inference, cloud infrastructure or datacentre operations * GPU and infrastructure monitoring tools such as nvidia-smi, DCGM, Prometheus or Grafana * Experience with telemetry, time-series data or technical benchmarks * Experience choosing or setting up BI and data tools such as Metabase, Power BI, Looker or dbt * Linux, APIs and databases * Product, web or billing analytics * Pricing, unit economics or capacity forecasting * European energy markets or datacentre economics **Education & Qualifications** * BSc/MSc in a quantitative discipline OR equivalent practical experience **Remuneration** * Highly competitive package, dependent on experience * 25 days paid annual leave * Hybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office, with remote flexibility * Free inference tokens! TensorX is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and assess candidates on the skills and experience the role requires. Please let us know if you need any reasonable accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process. **\*\*\*\*\*\*\* NO AGENCY ASSISTANCE REQUIRED \*\*\*\*\*\*\***

title: Data Platform Engineer - Cybersecurity
description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About The Team** We are a newly formed, forward-looking Cybersecurity Data Engineering & Platform Team driving the future of our enterprise defense strategy. Our mission is to build a next-generation, centralized data lakehouse that unifies all security telemetry into a single, high-performance ecosystem. Operating across two specialized verticals—Data Logistics (ingestion, enrichment, and semantic layers) and Data Platform (foundational infrastructure, security architecture, and AI enablement)—we are designing a scalable, cloud-native foundation from the ground up. By combining cutting-edge data architecture with advanced analytics, we empower our threat hunters, data scientists, and incident responders with the real-time, trusted intelligence needed to protect the enterprise at scale. Operating across distributed hubs in Dublin, US, and New Zealand, we are the team responsible for ensuring the underlying architecture is highly performant, automated, and governed by strict enterprise standards. We are actively moving away from our SIEM-based data platform toward a modern, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) model. title: Graduate Field Service Engineer
location: Lucan and Pettycanon, South Dublin, Ireland
description: **Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.** For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. **Start your engineering career at the heart of cutting-edge technology** What if your first engineering role could take you from Ireland to some of the world’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing facilities? At **ASM** , we develop the technologies used to manufacture the computer chips powering modern life, from **AI and smartphones to 5G, autonomous vehicles and medical technology** . For more than 50 years, innovation has been at the heart of what we do. Today, our engineers work at the forefront of semiconductor technologies including **Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), epitaxy, PEALD, PECVD, vertical furnaces and silicon carbide epitaxy** . We are now looking for a **Graduate Field Service Engineer** to join our team in Ireland. If you are an engineering graduate who enjoys **hands-on problem solving, working with complex technology, travelling internationally and learning by doing** , this could be the start of an exciting career with ASM. **What will you do?** As a Graduate Field Service Engineer, you will receive training and support to build your expertise on some of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment in the world. **You Will** * Install and commission advanced semiconductor equipment at customer sites. * Support the qualification, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of ASM systems. * Work hands-on with complex electrical, mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. * Help install ASM's latest-generation equipment and new technologies at customer sites. * Troubleshoot technical challenges, identify root causes and help develop long-term solutions. * Work alongside experienced engineers and collaborate with international and cross-functional teams. * Build strong relationships with customers and provide high-quality technical support. * Develop your skills in technical reporting, project management, problem solving and customer communication. * Work in highly advanced cleanroom environments where semiconductor devices are manufactured. You'll be doing real engineering from the start, with the opportunity to see the impact of your work firsthand. **Where could this role take you?** This isn't a typical desk-based graduate role. You'll be based in **Ireland** and spend significant time working directly at customer sites. As part of ASM's international Field Service organization, you will also have opportunities to travel to customer and ASM locations across **Europe** , **North America, Asia or the Middle East** . Travel can represent **up to 75% of the role** , combining work at local customer sites with assignments at other locations. For graduates who enjoy variety, meeting new people and gaining international experience early in their career, this is a unique opportunity to develop both technically and professionally. **What are we looking for?** You don't need years of industry experience. **We're looking for graduates with the curiosity, practical mindset and motivation to learn.** **You Could Be a Great Match If You Have** * A Bachelor's degree (Level 8 or higher) in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic, Mechatronic Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * An interest in hands-on engineering, equipment and technology. * A practical approach to solving problems and learning new systems. * Strong communication skills in English. Additional European languages are a plus. * Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP or similar systems is beneficial but not essential. * A willingness and ability to travel extensively. * A valid driver's license. * A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working with people from different cultures and backgrounds. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is **curious, adaptable and excited to learn** . **What will you get from ASM?** Your first role after university should help you build a career, not just give you a job. **At ASM, You'll Have The Opportunity To** * Start your career with a global leader in semiconductor process technology. * Receive advanced technical training at ASM's global training facilities. * Learn directly from experienced engineers and technical specialists. * Gain hands-on experience with highly advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. * Build valuable expertise in troubleshooting, customer engineering, project management and semiconductor technology. * Work in an international environment and gain exposure to customers and colleagues around the world. * Access ongoing career development and learning opportunities within ASM. * Receive a competitive graduate package, including base salary, bonus, pension and private healthcare. * Join a supportive, collaborative and international engineering community. **Please note:** Candidates must already have the **right to work in Ireland** to be considered for this position. **Build What's Next With Us** At ASM, our people are at the heart of our technology. We believe the best ideas come from bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people can learn, develop their talents and do their best work. If you're graduating in engineering and looking for a role where you can **get hands-on with technology, travel, solve real-world problems and build an international career** , we'd love to hear from you. **Ready to turn your engineering degree into real-world impact? Apply today and start your journey with ASM.** **Apply Today To Be Part Of What’s Next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. *ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer
description: **About ElevenLabs** ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. **We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms** * ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. * ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. * ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. No task is above or beneath you. * AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. * Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. * Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer * Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. * Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. * Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. * Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. * Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún * Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. **About The Role** We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join the ElevenLabs Security team. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of security, software and infrastructure engineering, building the platforms, controls and tooling that let teams ship and operate cloud infrastructure securely at high velocity. **You Will** * Design and build security tools and guardrails that integrate directly into our infrastructure and products * Partner with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to review application architectures, develop threat models and build in secure by default patterns throughout the software development lifecycle * Identify, prioritise and remediate security vulnerabilities, working directly with engineers and contributing to fixes where required, across the entire stack. * Ship new security features which directly improve the security posture of our products in production * Design and implement supply chain security controls across build and deployment pipelines, including artefact signing, provenance, dynamic admission controls and SBOM generation **Requirements** * Strong engineering background, with experience building and shipping production systems * Proven track record of building and scaling security programs * Fluency in at least one programming language (Python, Typescript, Golang etc) with the ability to read, write and maintain production quality code * Hands on experience in cloud-native environments (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) * Strong understanding of cloud security fundamentals: IAM, networking, PKI, linux internals * Experience securing CI/CD pipelines to prevent supply chain attacks **Bonus** * Experience securing AI or Machine Learning systems, including training pipelines * Background in developer experience or platform engineering, especially building developer tooling * Contributions to open source security projects, published research or talks at security conferences * Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO27001, PCI, HIPAA or similar) Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London or Warsaw We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Inside Sales Account Executive
description: **About Viktor** Viktor is the AI employee that lives in Slack and Microsoft Teams, connects to thousands of tools, and does the work: reports, dashboards, code, campaigns. Our mission is to give every company an AI employee. The team is small. The scope is not. **The Short Version** You join our Inside Sales team as one of its first Account Executives, reporting to our Inside Sales lead. New customers find Viktor and start paying on their own. Your job is to get them set up and spending, grow them through their first 28 days, then hand them to an AI Performance Consultant. Farmer, not hunter. **What's Actually Going On Here** Viktor is growing fast, and new customers arrive through the product every day. Many of them clearly need a bigger plan or a longer-term contract, and their first weeks decide how far they go. Leads are routed to Inside Sales by our GTM engine in Attio, and you use product and billing signals to decide who to talk to and how to grow them. The pipeline already exists in the product data. You work it. The Inside Sales team is small and early. You work alongside the reps already in seat and help write the playbook the team runs on. **What You'll Actually Do** * Get new customers set up and spending, then right-size them: find teams that use far more than they pay for and move them onto the right plans. * Own each account for its first 28 days, then hand it to an AI Performance Consultant with a clean handover. Enterprise accounts sit with our Enterprise Sales team. * Build your own target lists from usage and billing data, and decide who to talk to next. * Run a consultative process. Short cycles, product-led conversations, real usage on the table. * Improve the playbook the team runs on: talk tracks, follow-up templates, agent workflows. What converts, what messaging lands, what objections recur. Answers come from data, not guesses. **How You'll Know It's Working** * You work the inside-sales flow independently at the team's standard, with clean day-28 handovers. * Accounts you touch end up on the right plans, and their usage keeps growing. * What your accounts spend in their first 28 days is tracked every week against your target. * Your pipeline is current in Attio, with call notes coming through from Gong. * The rest of the team uses at least one improvement you made to the playbook. **Who You Are** * 2 to 4 years of closing experience in B2B SaaS. * At least 2 years in a product-led conversion, expansion or sales-assist motion (think Notion, Airtable, Miro, Figma and similar), or closing experience at an AI-native company. * Full-lifecycle seller: you source from product signal, run discovery, close, and stay close post-sale. * Comfortable with data. Usage dashboards, billing history, building your own lists. SQL is a plus. * AI-native, with evidence. Either you already sell with AI today (prospecting, research and follow-ups run through agents in your current role) or you've sold at an AI company. You can't sell Viktor without living the workflow. * Comfortable as an early rep, without enablement or sales ops scaffolding. * Based in (or ready to relocate to) Warsaw or Dublin. * Fluent English. German, French or Polish a plus. **Probably Not a Fit If** * Enterprise-only deals with 9-month cycles are your home turf. * SDRs have always fed you meetings. * Quota is the only number you care about, and you change logo every 18 months. * "Leverage" comes up in your sentences more often than customers do. **Even Better If** * You have early-stage startup experience. Employee #1 to #20. * You've sold AI, automation, or agent products and know how buyers evaluate this category. * You've built your own book of business with SQL or analytics tooling. **The Hard Part** Volume is high, every account runs on a 28-day clock, and the product changes weekly. **Why This Role Is Different** You take a founding seat in a small Inside Sales team, working a product customers already pay for and expand on their own. The people who build the playbook now are first in line as Inside Sales and Enterprise grow. **How We Work** Small team, high trust, low process. Decisions are made by owners, not committees. You will ship your first week. You will talk to users your first day. We don't do alignment meetings or stakeholder syncs. We build things, see if they work, and iterate. **Why Viktor** We're one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. The product works. The market is pulling. This is a rare window: everyone here owns something real. Not a task. A surface of the company that customers depend on. That doesn't last forever. Right now, it's still true. **Compensation** Top-of-the-market salary and the kind of ownership that only exists at this stage. The best work happens when you're in the room. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland and Warsaw, Poland

title: Security Industry Specialist (Regulatory Operations Center), AWS Security & Security Assurance
description: **Description** At AWS, Security is priority zero. As part of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security team, we are looking for a technically deep Industry Specialist who is passionate about owning far-reaching projects to drive continuous improvement across AWS at unparalleled scale. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. title: Software Developer — Get Paid to Build Your Own Project with an AI Coding Assistant
description: **Software Developer — Build Your Own Project with an AI Coding Assistant** **About The Role** What if you could get paid to work on the project you've been meaning to build — with a state-of-the-art AI coding assistant at your side, completely free of charge? We're looking for software developers in the Dublin area to bring their own projects and build them using an AI-powered coding assistant. You write real code on real projects you care about. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for developers who want to ship their own work — and get compensated for it. * Organization: Alignerr * Type: Hourly Contract * Location: Fully Remote * Commitment: Flexible **What You'll Do** * Bring a software project you personally own — a side project, a tool, an open-source library, or something you've been meaning to finish * Build features, fix bugs, refactor code, write docs, or do whatever your project needs — using an AI coding assistant * At each step, compare two versions of the assistant's response, choose the better one, and write a brief explanation of your reasoning * Work in your own environment, on your own schedule, with your own tools **Who You Are** * A developer with a software project you personally own, stored in a git repository * Comfortable working in the terminal and with git-based workflows * Running macOS, Linux, or Windows with WSL2 * Able to write clear, honest evaluations — you'll explain your choices in a few sentences * Self-motivated and reliable when working independently * Open-source maintainers are especially welcome **What's Eligible** * Software projects that you personally and solely own * Open-source projects with an approved license * If your project has other maintainers, mention it in your application — we'll confirm eligibility **What's Not Eligible** * Work owned by an employer, client, university, company, or startup * Projects under NDA * AI model training or evaluation projects; title: Water Engineer
description: **The Opportunity** THE OPPORTUNITY Help solve some of Ireland's most important drinking water challenges. At Stantec, you'll work alongside experienced engineers and specialists to develop the treatment processes and infrastructure that provide safe, reliable drinking water to communities across Ireland. From upgrading existing water treatment plants to improving water quality, resilience and operational performance, you'll help shape the future of drinking water services. We're looking to grow our team with talented, curious and ambitious people who want to make a difference. Whether you're developing your technical expertise, building leadership skills or working alongside some of the most respected drinking water specialists in the industry, you'll be supported to grow both professionally and personally. As pressures on water quality, climate resilience and supply security continue to increase, the need for sustainable and innovative treatment solutions has never been greater. By joining our team, you'll help protect public health, safeguard the environment and strengthen drinking water supplies for future generations. **About The Role** As an Engineer within our Water team, you'll help clients solve some of Ireland's most complex drinking water challenges while contributing to projects that improve water quality, strengthen resilience and safeguard drinking water supplies for communities across the country. **You'll Have The Opportunity To** + Undertake and review process calculations, treatment performance assessments and optimisation studies. + Support the selection and specification of drinking water treatment technologies. + Develop practical and sustainable treatment solutions tailored to individual water sources. + Work closely with clients, contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary project teams. + Contribute to projects from feasibility and concept development through to detailed design, construction and commissioning. From conventional processes such as coagulation, flocculation, clarification, filtration and disinfection through to supplementary solutions such as activated carbon for organics removal, you'll help develop treatment strategies tailored to the unique characteristics of each water source. One day you might be investigating colour and natural organic matter in an upland surface water source, the next optimising conditioning requirements for a groundwater supply. Understanding how raw water characteristics influence treatment performance, and applying water chemistry, process engineering and operational thinking to solve those challenges, is what makes this role both technically rewarding and genuinely engaging. You'll join a well-established and supportive team that will help you settle in, develop your expertise and build confidence. As your experience grows, you'll be given the autonomy and responsibility to take ownership of your work, while always having access to support and guidance when needed. Client engagement is a fundamental part of the role. You'll work closely with clients to understand their challenges and objectives, helping develop solutions that deliver meaningful outcomes and build the trusted relationships that underpin our success. YOUR IMPACT The work you do will help protect the future of drinking water in Ireland. Across the country, raw water sources are facing increasing challenges from climate change, changing water quality and growing demands on supply resilience. Your work will help address these challenges through sustainable treatment solutions that protect public health, support environmental stewardship and strengthen water security. At Stantec, one of our core values is We Do What Is Right . That means developing solutions that are not only technically excellent, but also environmentally responsible and focused on long-term outcomes for the communities we serve. This is more than project delivery. It's an opportunity to help safeguard one of Ireland's most valuable natural resources, protect our proud heritage of high-quality drinking water and make a lasting contribution to communities across Ireland. **About You** You're a motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and wants to make a meaningful contribution to Ireland's drinking water future. Beyond technical capability, we're looking for someone who is collaborative, curious and passionate about what they do. You enjoy working with others, bringing energy to projects and helping clients, communities and colleagues achieve the best possible outcomes. You understand that successful solutions are developed by listening to different perspectives and balancing competing priorities. Whether working with ecologists, environmental scientists, operators, planners, regulators or fellow engineers, you'll appreciate that technical excellence is only part of the answer. You're also a strong communicator, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly and adapt your approach for different audiences, from technical specialists through to clients and non-technical stakeholders. **Key Attributes And Experience Include** * Bachelor's degree in Civil, Environmental, Chemical or Process Engineering, or a related discipline. * Chartered Engineer status or working towards chartership. * Experience in drinking water treatment, water infrastructure or related water sector projects. * Knowledge of drinking water treatment technologies, water quality objectives and industry best practice. * Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. * Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and engaging with a range of stakeholders. * A passion for sustainable water solutions and protecting Ireland's water resources. **WHY JOIN US** * We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed. * We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025. = * We do what is right: Industry leading training and development as well as paid for professional subscriptions. A professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered. * We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment to assist with the growth of your career. * Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the Ireland - we want you to be part of it! * Great Benefits: Competitive salary, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard! **About Stantec** Whether you’re starting out on your engineering career or are looking for a fresh challenge, Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, is a great career move. Based in Dublin, Galway, Castlebar and Cork, we are actively recruiting for team players with experience in any of the following areas – water and wastewater treatment process and network design, integrated network management, structural design, site development, road and bridge engineering, project management and administration. You’ll be working for a dynamic company with an excellent reputation in the industry. Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, offers a great working environment amongst friendly professionals with an emphasis on teamwork. It’s a company where your ideas and opinions will be valued and your efforts recognised and rewarded. We have been awarded the silver Investors in Diversity accreditation by the Irish Centre for Diversity for our commitment to quality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) in the workplace.
